public_rationale: The September 2023 paper reports both successful calculations and errors, including 93.03% overall accuracy for the 2-billion-parameter MathGLM model [e1]. These results cannot settle whether the paper “proves” its title without a specified standard distinguishing demonstrated capability from calculator-like reliability [e1].
limitations: The reported accuracy does not establish guaranteed correctness, and the reported errors do not establish an absence of calculator-free capability.
There is no agreed reliability threshold for deciding whether the experiments prove the title.
